introduction: Montana LIHEAP helps eligible households with heating expenses. Heating-season applications run October1 through April30.
description: Montana LIHEAP helps eligible households with heating expenses. Heating-season applications run October1 through April30.

sections.who: Income and resources affect eligibility. Homeowners and renters can apply; existing SNAP, SSI or TANF may establish eligibility.
sections.get: Assistance supports qualifying home-energy costs. Ask the local office about urgent heating-system problems.
sections.docs:
• Household income and resource records.
  • Heating account and fuel information.
  • Requested identity and residence proof.
sections.apply:
1. Find the office

    Use DPHHS local or Tribal office links.

  2. Complete combined intake

    Fill the LIHEAP and Weatherization application, then print and deliver or mail it as instructed.

  3. Explain emergencies

    Contact the office directly about loss of heat.
sections.after: Check status with the office. Submission alone does not prevent disconnection.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using LIHEAP seasonal intake and eligibility. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
